basic_profile.bio: Avid fantasy hockey player and dedicated Redditor from Fort Erie, Canada. With a passion for statistics and strategy, I spend my free time managing multiple fantasy teams across different platforms. By day, I'm a data analyst for a tech startup, allowing me to work flexibly and often check Reddit during breaks. I love video games, particularly the Fallout series, and enjoy exploring the latest in cryptocurrency. I'm in a long-term relationship, and my partner and I share a love for travel, though I often battle a fear of flying. Typically online during late evenings, especially when games are on.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a lifelong passion for hockey, I have honed my analytical skills through years of managing fantasy teams and working in data analytics. I frequently self-teach new skills related to my job and hobbies, staying updated with the latest trends in both tech and sports analytics.
